description: This source file defines the 'PortGuardian' actor, responsible for managing and monitoring network ports, including recording port usage, listening for active connections, reporting port status, and handling cleanup tasks in a macOS application. It includes functions for interacting with system processes to gather information, perform port scans, and maintain records of port activity.

classes.name: PortGuardian
classes.description: An actor that manages network port monitoring, recording, and cleanup operations, including listening to active ports, inspecting process commands, and generating reports about port status.

classes.name: PortReport
classes.description: Struct representing a report of a network port's status, including expected usage, current listeners, and potential interference.

classes.name: ReportListener
classes.description: Class encapsulating information about a port listener, including process ID, command, and expected status.

methods.name: sweep
methods.description: Performs a sweep of ports, attempting to identify and kill unexpected listeners based on the connection mode.

methods.name: record
methods.description: Records information about a port usage including port number, process ID, command, and mode.

methods.name: removeRecord
methods.description: Removes a recorded port activity based on process ID.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Provides a descriptor for a given port, including process ID, command, and executable path.

methods.name: diagnose
methods.description: Inspects current port listeners and generates reports on their status.

methods.name: probeGatewayHealth
methods.description: Checks the health of the gateway via an HTTP request to localhost.

methods.name: isListening
methods.description: Checks if a port is actively being listened on, optionally for a specific process ID.

methods.name: listeners
methods.description: Retrieves a list of listeners on a given port by invoking system commands.

methods.name: readFullCommand
methods.description: Reads the full command line for a process given its process ID.

methods.name: parseListeners
methods.description: Parses system command output to extract listener information.

methods.name: buildReport
methods.description: Constructs a detailed port report based on current listeners and expected behavior.

methods.name: executablePath
methods.description: Retrieves the executable path for a process given its PID, platform-dependent.

methods.name: kill
methods.description: Attempts to terminate a process by PID, first gracefully then forcibly if needed.

methods.name: isExpected
methods.description: Determines whether a listener on a port matches expected criteria based on mode.

methods.name: probeGatewayHealthIfNeeded
methods.description: Checks gateway health conditionally based on mode and listener presence.

methods.name: loadRecords
methods.description: Loads saved port activity records from disk.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current port activity records to disk.
